description: Source code implementing the RRC Reestablishment Procedure for a 5G NR UE, including handling reestablishment requests, fallback procedures, security verification, context transfer, and message sending.

classes.name: rrc_reestablishment_procedure
classes.description: Class implementing the 5G NR RRC Reestablishment procedure, managing request handling, context transfer, security, and message exchange.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine handling the reestablishment process, including fallback, context transfer, message sending, and response handling.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reestablishment_fallback
methods.description: Handles fallback to RRC Setup procedure if reestablishment is not accepted.

methods.name: is_reestablishment_accepted
methods.description: Checks if the reestablishment request is valid and acceptable.

methods.name: verify_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context of the reestablishment request using short MAC.

methods.name: transfer_reestablishment_context_and_update_keys
methods.description: Transfers UE context and updates security keys after successful reestablishment.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Creates and activates SRB1 for the UE.

methods.name: send_rrc_reestablishment
methods.description: Constructs and sends the RRC Reestablishment message to the UE.

methods.name: enable_srb1_ciphering
methods.description: Enables ciphering on SRB1 after message transmission.

methods.name: log_rejected_reestablishment
methods.description: Logs reasons for rejecting reestablishment requests.
